newsitem.title: USA: Court rejects Campbell motion against Heinz. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Court rejects Campbell motion against Heinz. [CORRECTED 23:50 GMT]

text.p: A federal judge has rejected a motion by Campbell Soup Co to enforce what it thought was an agreement H.J. Heinz Co, Heinz said Tuesday. The judge found no agreement was ever reached, it added.
The ruling by U.S. District Judge Joseph Irenas allows the dispute over Daniel O'Neill, former head of Campbell's soup division, to go to trial, Heinz said.
Heinz hired O'Neill to head its pet food and Star-Kist tuna operations. The company has said his duties will not put him in competition with Campbell.
Campbell had said its agreement with O'Neill prevented him from taking the Heinz job.
Heinz did not say when the case would be tried. Officials at the company were not available for comment.
